div.style: color: rgb(17, 48, 28) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stage 2 · bootstrap
sts get-caller-identity
assert it matches AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
create state bucket if absent
versioning · SSE · TLS-only policy

div.style: color: rgb(17, 32, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stage 3 · apply-registry
terraform apply
-target aws_ecr_repository.api
nothing else yet

div.style: color: rgb(17, 32, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stage 4 · build
docker buildx build and push
tag is the commit SHA
provenance false, Lambda needs it

div.style: color: rgb(17, 32, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Stage 5 · apply
terraform apply, full
-var image_tag=SHA
-var builder_enabled=false
then wait services-stable

div.style: color: rgb(17, 32, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stage 6 · corpus
aws s3 sync --delete
invoke Lambda reindex
fail if 0 indexed or any failed

div.style: color: rgb(17, 48, 28) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

/health returns 200
UI contains RAG Console
/ready shows index_exists
real question returns citations

div.style: color: rgb(58, 49, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Why the split
Terraform creates the ECR repository, but the ECS
service and the Lambda both reference an image tag
inside it. A single apply would fail on first run,
because the tag does not exist yet.
